theorems.statement: ∀ {α E F : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] (μ ν : Measure α) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (a : ℕ → α → E) (a₀ : α → E) (b : ℕ → α → F) (b₀ : α → F), c ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (a j) μ) → AEStronglyMeasurable a₀ μ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (b j) ν) → AEStronglyMeasurable b₀ ν → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖a j x - a₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖b j x - b₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ x, ‖a j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ c * ∫⁻ x, ‖b j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν) → ∫⁻ x, ‖a₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ c * ∫⁻ x, ‖b₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν
